title: No need to set days
body: First habit tracking app doesn’t ask me to select a day.   I just want to start it doing it twice a week and don’t want to get bog down by doing it on Tuesday or Wednesday.   Finally someone understands this! Thank you Kevin!
author: ggxie

title: Streaks
body: I recommend to make the week streaks with the addition of days streak for us to choose, for example like choose what we prefer to use to display out, it would be more effective, in my opinion!
author: ClareFlare
